score.missing: Any unavailable canonical player/Character root or invalid source observation rejects publication of the entire snapshot; never omit that player or supply zero
score.zero: Qualified empty Character root yields genuine current count0; no history claim

ordering.rng: No random draw in comparisons/requests/replay. Optional lottery remains existing pure seam only, not activated.

refresh.trigger: Each MID301 subtype37 request after client close/reopen cache clear
refresh.semantics: Fresh coherent full cohort; immutable generation + retained metric provenance. No live polling/socket refresh.
refresh.retention: Never silently trim snapshots referenced by period settlement or semantic operation receipts; later archival must preserve immutable references

titles.rule: Firstpersistedsnapshotbindsoneweeklyperiod atomically. Subsequentfreshrequests cannotreplaceitswinners. Missingweekswithoutsnapshotgrantnothing, neverinventhistoricalwinners. Processpendingrecordedperiodsonrequests throughsameownerentry; futureworkeriswakeuponly.
titles.starts: Bound snapshot authoritative observed instant, immutable even if application delayed; expiresAt=start+604800, no refresh on replay/select/read
titles.revocation: No early revocation guessed; each genuine award remains eligible until fixed expiry. Different weekly origins may coexist.
titles.delivery: Atomic Ranking settlement record + typed PlayerDisplay.ReceiveOriginTx mirror with I4-owned sorted winner root315 locks before Ranking600. Source policy/content/generation/week/recipient/rank/title/time form immutable semantic identity.

wire.request: rank_types array of subtype37, not catalog16001 or metric1001; reject unsupported/mixed subtypes until owning profiles qualified
wire.presentation: I4 directory fields are display-only, never score/membership authority. Missing required directory rejects snapshot projection; no invented player name/avatar.

origins.rule: Extend typed per-catalog External origin seam; retained whole-family External port compatible. Do not label whole title/bubble family complete. Ranking reads own immutable settlements to establish award truth, recipient ledger alone not proof.
origins.others: All other selected actual origin sources remain unavailable under their own contracts

time.instant: Existing generation.TimedRunner DB-authoritative instant pinned once before retry/locks
time.stale: Reject bound instant older than observed root; do not resample while waiting/retrying
time.clock: UTC, no universal WorkPlace05reset inference; future policy version explicit. Backward jumps cannot refresh expiry or award same period twice.
